title: Tightened unit QC before ratio publishing
points: Step 12 now resolves peer-confirmed cumulative statement unit labels before publishing to D1, fixing rows where a filing section was tagged as millions even though the peer section showed the same thousands-scale values.

Ambiguous thousands/rupees cumulative rows stay QC-flagged and are excluded from ratio inputs, while LTM rows now carry forward known scale-discontinuity warnings until the series exits the bad scale band.
Production D1 statements, ratios, and quality flags were refreshed. The latest health matrix shows 57 open flags, 17 yellow cells, and 0 red cells across the latest 12 periods.
